name: Trapped: Forced To Kill
source:
You’re invited to Evercrest Sports University, a prestigious school reserved for the most talented athletes. Your final interview begins and then everything goes wrong.

You wake up bound in a place that looks nothing like a campus, trapped with eleven frightened strangers and forced into twisted Killing Games where every choice could be your last.

[From [url=https://tjs-productions.itch.io/trapped-forced-to-kill]Itch.io[/url]]
